dogecoin.text: I guess this is the $DOGE rocket now

News — SpaceX, the day after Elon Musk's doge-filled appearance on SNL, announces it is accepting $DOGE to pay for a payload on a lunar Falcon 9 mission next year.

SpaceX VP Tom Ochinero: "We're excited to launch DOGE-1 to the Moon!" https://t.co/gUhFzaP2X7

Maye Musk: "I'm excited for my Mother's Day gift. I just hope it's not Dogecoin..."

Elon Musk: "It is"
